The background is completely black, which makes the subject stand out prominently. The man appears to be middle-aged or older. Above the portrait, there is a quote in white text that reads: "Each dream you leave behind is a part of your future that will no longer exist." The overall mood of the image is contemplative and motivational. The black-and-white color scheme adds a timeless and classic feel to the photograph.
